---
name: Feature request
description: Propose a focused Codex Scope capability backed by a real use case
---

## Problem

What Codex behavior is hard to understand or reproduce today?

## Current evidence

Link current Codex documentation/source/issues or describe a sanitized real-world case. An issue report is useful demand evidence but is not automatically a semantic specification.

## Desired outcome

What question should Codex Scope answer?

## Why existing commands are insufficient

Explain why `inspect`, `instructions`, `config`, `why`, or current native Codex diagnostics do not already solve the problem.

## Safety / privacy considerations

Would this require reading additional files, paths, credentials, hooks, network state, or session state?
